arxiv-2112-07514.title: Proper holomorphic embeddings of complements of large Cantor sets in ℂ 2 \mathbb{C}^{2} .
arxiv-2112-07514.creator: G. D. Di Salvo, E. F. Wold
arxiv-2112-07514.description: Abstract . We presents a construction of a proper holomorphic embedding f : ℙ 1 ∖ C ↪ ℂ 2 f\colon\mathbb{P}^{1}\setminus C\hookrightarrow\mathbb{C}^{2} , where C C is a Cantor set obtained by removing smaller and smaller vertical and horizontal strips from a square of side 2, allowing to realize it to have Lebesgue measure arbitrarily close to 4.

arxiv-2210-11404.title: Self-Supervised Learning with Masked Image Modeling for Teeth Numbering, Detection of Dental Restorations, and Instance Segmentation in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
arxiv-2210-11404.creator: Amani Almalki, Longin Jan Latecki
arxiv-2210-11404.description: Abstract The computer-assisted radiologic informative report is currently emerging in dental practice to facilitate dental care and reduce time consumption in manual panoramic radiographic interpretation. However, the amount of dental radiographs for training is very limited, particularly from the point of view of deep learning.

arxiv-2303-16817.title: Adaptive Superpixel for Active Learning in Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2303-16817.creator: Hoyoung Kim, Minhyeon Oh, Sehyun Hwang, Suha Kwak, Jungseul Ok, Graduate School of AI, POSTECH, Dept. of CSE, POSTECH {cskhy16, minhyeonoh, sehyun03, suha.kwak, jungseul}@postech.ac.kr
arxiv-2303-16817.description: Abstract Learning semantic segmentation requires pixel-wise annotations, which can be time-consuming and expensive. To reduce the annotation cost, we propose a superpixel-based active learning (AL) framework, which collects a dominant label per superpixel instead. To be specific, it consists of adaptive superpixel and sieving mechanisms, fully dedicated to AL.

arxiv-2306-06879.title: Arrhenius law for interacting diffusive systems
arxiv-2306-06879.creator: Vishwajeet Kumar, Arnab Pal, Ohad Shpielberg
arxiv-2306-06879.description: Abstract Finding the mean time it takes for a particle to escape from a meta-stable state due to thermal fluctuations is a fundamental problem in physics, chemistry and biology. For weak thermal noise, the mean escape time is captured by the Arrhenius law (AL).

arxiv-2311-15516.title: Active Foundational Models for Fault Diagnosis of Electrical Motors Journal: Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2311-15516.creator: Sriram Anbalagan, Sai Shashank GP, Deepesh Agarwal, Balasubramaniam Natarajan, Babji Srinivasan
arxiv-2311-15516.description: Abstract Fault detection and diagnosis of electrical motors are of utmost importance in ensuring the safe and reliable operation of several industrial systems. Detection and diagnosis of faults at the incipient stage allows corrective actions to be taken in order to reduce the severity of faults.

arxiv-2406-00261.title: Finite groups with geodetic Cayley graphs
arxiv-2406-00261.creator: Murray Elder, Adam Piggott, Florian Stober, Alexander Thumm, Armin Weiß
arxiv-2406-00261.description: Abstract . A connected undirected graph is called geodetic if for every pair of vertices there is a unique shortest path connecting them. It has been conjectured that for finite groups, the only geodetic Cayley graphs are odd cycles and complete graphs.

arxiv-2406-14314.title: Identifying User Goals From UI Trajectories
arxiv-2406-14314.creator: Omri Berkovitch, Sapir Caduri, Noam Kahlon, Anatoly Efros, Avi Caciularu, Ido Dagan
arxiv-2406-14314.description: Abstract . Identifying underlying user goals and intents has been recognized as valuable in various personalization-oriented settings, such as personalized agents, improved search responses, advertising, user analytics, and more. In this paper, we propose a new task—goal identification from observed UI trajectories—aiming to infer the user’s detailed intentions when performing a task within UI environments.

arxiv-2410-00178.title: Streaming Data in HPC Workflows Using ADIOS
arxiv-2410-00178.creator: Greg Eisenhauer 1, Norbert Podhorszki 2, Ana Gainaru 2, Scott Klasky 2, Philip E. Davis 3, Manish Parashar 3, Matthew Wolf 7, Eric Suchtya 2, Erick Fredj 4, Vicente Bolea 5, Franz Pöschel 6, Klaus Steiniger 6, Michael Bussmann 6, Richard Pausch 8, Sunita Chandrasekaran 9
arxiv-2410-00178.description: Abstract The “IO Wall” problem, in which the gap between computation rate and data access rate grows continuously, poses significant problems to scientific workflows which have traditionally relied upon using the filesystem for intermediate storage between workflow stages. One way to avoid this problem in scientific workflows is to stream data directly from producers to consumers and avoiding storage entirely.

arxiv-2410-07056.title: Towards a benchmark for quantum computers based on an iterated post-selective protocol
arxiv-2410-07056.creator: Adrian Ortega, Orsolya Kálmán, Tamás Kiss
arxiv-2410-07056.description: Abstract Applying post selection in each step of an iterated protocol leads to sensitive quantum dynamics that may be utilized to test and benchmark current quantum computers. An example of this type of protocols was originally proposed for the task of matching an unknown quantum state to a reference state.

arxiv-2502-03742.title: Radio emission from little red dots may reveal their true nature
arxiv-2502-03742.creator: Muhammad A. Latif, Ammara Aftab, Daniel J. Whalen, Mar Mezcua
arxiv-2502-03742.description: Abstract Context. Aims. The unprecedented sensitivity of the James Webb Space Telescope ( JWST ) has revolutionized our understanding of the early universe. Among the most intriguing JWST discoveries are red, very compact objects showing broad line emission features nicknamed as little red dots (LRDs).

arxiv-2503-19241.title: Exact identifiability analysis for a class of partially observed near-linear stochastic differential equation models
arxiv-2503-19241.creator: Alexander P Browning, Michael J Chappell, Hamid Rahkooy, Torkel E Loman, Ruth E Baker
arxiv-2503-19241.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander P Browning, Michael J Chappell, Hamid Rahkooy, Torkel E Loman, Ruth E Baker. Stochasticity plays a key role in many biological systems, necessitating the calibration of stochastic mathematical models to interpret associated data. For model parameters to be estimated reliably, it is typically the case that they must be structurally identifiable. Yet, while theory underlying structural identifiability analysis for deterministic differential equation models is highly developed, there are currently no tools for the general assessment of stochastic models.

pmc-11433185.title: Glucose-Free Solutions Mediated Inhibition of Oxidative Stress and Oxidative Stress-Related Damages in Peritoneal Dialysis: A Promising Solution
pmc-11433185.creator: Anna Basso, Martina Cacciapuoti, Lucia Federica Stefanelli, Federico Nalesso, Lorenzo A. Calò
pmc-11433185.description: Oxidative stress (OxSt) and inflammation are common in end-stage renal disease and dialysis patients; they are known risk factors for cardiovascular disease and mortality. In peritoneal dialysis (PD), OxSt and inflammation are even further increased compared to the already increased oxidative stress of their pre-dialysis phase.

pmc-11438319.title: Eruption and caries status of first permanent molars in children aged 6–7 years in Shijingshan District, Beijing, China
pmc-11438319.creator: Mei Zhao, Zhaoyou Wang, Min Liu, Ziqi Song, Rong Wang, Lina Yang
pmc-11438319.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundDental caries is still a major disease that affect the oral health of people in China. First permanent molars (FPMs) are the most caries-susceptible teeth among school-aged children. The aim of this study was to investigate the eruption and caries status of first permanent molars in children aged 6–7 years in Shijingshan District, Beijing, China, to provide information for oral health promotion.Methods The study was a cross-sectional survey conducted in 6-7-year-old first grade children from public elementary schools in Shijingshan District, Beijing.

pmc-12593877.title: Posterior-stabilized vs cruciate-retaining TKA in osteoarthritic patients with genu recurvatum: a 2-year comparative analysis
pmc-12593877.creator: Rui Sheng Wang, Jia Ying Lee, Mitra Amit Kanta, Lincoln Ming Han Liow, Jerry Yongqiang Chen, Paul Chee Cheng Chang, Seng Jin Yeo
pmc-12593877.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionPre-operative genu recurvatum (GR) in patients with knee osteoarthritis (OA) presents a surgical challenge during total knee arthroplasty (TKA). It remains unclear whether cruciate-retaining (CR) or posterior-stabilized (PS) TKA offers superior functional recovery and postoperative stability in this population.MethodsIn this single-centre retrospective cohort study, we analysed 102 patients with knee OA and physiological GR > 5° who underwent either CR-TKA (n = 60) or PS-TKA (n = 42).

pmc-12619324.title: Habitat heterogeneity and green filamentous algae influence the larval ecology of Anopheles stephensi during the dry season in Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-12619324.creator: Araya Gebresilassie, Esayas Aklilu, Solomon Yared, Elyas Abdulahi, Kedir Adem Darasa, Ahmed Ali habib, Witka nore Witka, Hamedu Ahmed, Dagnew Hagezom, Tamiru Kassa, Dorian Jackson, Gonzalo M Vazquez-Prokopec
pmc-12619324.description: BackgroundThe recent invasion of Anopheles stephensi, an urban-adapted malaria vector, poses a threat to malaria elimination efforts in Africa. Understanding the larval ecology of this mosquito during the dry season, which represents a potential population bottleneck due to limited larval habitats and harsher environmental conditions, is critical for informing targeted interventions.

pmc-12827280.title: Limited therapeutic efficacy of N-acetyl-L-leucine in a mouse model of CLN1 disease
pmc-12827280.creator: Ewa A. Ziółkowska, Nicole A. Pagán Torres, Hsintsung Chen, Letitia L. Williams, Elizabeth M. Eultgen, Agnieszka Nowacka, Joshua T. Dearborn, Hemanth R. Nelvagal, Ineka T. Whiteman, Frances M. Platt, Jonathan D. Cooper
pmc-12827280.description: CLN1 disease, one of the most severe forms of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCLs or Batten disease), is a rapidly progressing pediatric neurodegenerative disorder caused by mutations in the PPT1 gene. The disease is characterized by lysosomal storage accumulation, an early onset neuroimmune response, motor impairment, and premature death.

pmc-13284341.title: Transabdominal Preperitoneal Repair With Concomitant Bowel Resection for Strangulated Femoral Hernias: A Report of Five Cases
pmc-13284341.creator: Tatsuya Suzuki, Yasuhiro Yamamoto, Kengo Shigehara, Daisei Watanabe, Katsuro Enomoto, Takahiro Nishikoshi
pmc-13284341.description: It is controversial whether prosthetic mesh can be used laparoscopically in emergency groin hernia repair when bowel resection is needed. While the guideline for emergency hernia repair recommends the use of prosthetic mesh in a clean-contaminated wound based on the studies with the open anterior approach, evidence supporting the laparoscopic use of prosthetic mesh in a clean-contaminated wound is scarce.

pmc-13380441.title: “No carrot, no stick”: Exploring premise identification programs across Canada
pmc-13380441.creator: Sherry Khoddami, Erin Fraser, Chelsea G. Himsworth, Anya F. Smith, Ellen Boyd
pmc-13380441.description: Premises Identification (PID) programs in Canada assign unique identification numbers to locations where animals, such as livestock and poultry, are kept. These programs are provincial and territorial, with a purpose of supporting various animal disease outbreaks, natural disaster emergencies, and animal traceability.

pmc-13714219.title: Intratumoral distribution of anisokaryosis in canine cutaneous mast cell tumors
pmc-13714219.creator: Christof A. Bertram, Frauke Wilm, Eda Parlak, Taryn A. Donovan, Hannah Janout, Pompei Bolfa, Michael J. Dark, Andrea Fuchs-Baumgartinger, Andrea Klang, Robert Klopfleisch, Barbara Richter, Marc Aubreville, Stephan M. Winkler, Matti Kiupel, Alexander Bartel
pmc-13714219.description: Automated measurements of anisokaryosis in canine cutaneous mast cell tumors (ccMCTs) have been shown to be predictive of survival, but questions remain regarding the intratumoral distribution of anisokaryosis. Whole-slide images of 96 ccMCTs were analyzed with a deep learning-based segmentation algorithm to quantify anisokaryosis using the standard deviation (SD) of the nuclear area.
